takes/18_doctor_a.mp3.txt: That's called nasal regurgitation.  When you swallow, your soft palate seals off your nose.  But laughing makes you breathe out so it drops and food can shoot right up.  Once in a while, it's harmless.  If it happens a lot, get it checked.
